name: Stellar Sleep
one_liner: Stellar Sleep is an insomnia program based on CBT-I, with 5–10 minute daily lessons, a sleep diary and relaxation audio.
best_for: Ongoing insomnia, as a structured CBT-I program
People who want short daily lessons
Tracking sleep with a diary and Apple Health
not_for: Possible sleep apnea or other medical sleep problems
short_description: Stellar Sleep is an insomnia program based on CBT-I, with 5–10 minute daily lessons, a sleep diary and relaxation audio.
long_description: Stellar Sleep is an insomnia program based on CBT-I, with 5–10 minute daily lessons, a sleep diary and relaxation audio. Daily lessons cover the core parts of CBT for insomnia, including sleep restriction, stimulus control and changing unhelpful thoughts, alongside a sleep diary and relaxation library. It started at Harvard Innovation Labs. A short low-cost first week is followed by a subscription. What it includes: Daily CBT-I lessons; Sleep diary and trends; Relaxation and sleep audio; Worry and gratitude journaling.

faqs.q: How much does Stellar Sleep cost?
faqs.a: Low-cost first week, then a subscription. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Stellar Sleep before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Stellar Sleep replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Stellar Sleep is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Stellar Sleep?
faqs.a: Stellar Sleep is available on iPhone and Android.
